title: A Friendship in Different Time Zones
fact_notes: 人物・具体的な出来事・結果は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Two friends who had grown up in the same neighborhood continued exchanging messages after one moved to another country.
sentences.ja: 同じ地域で育った友人二人は一人が別の国に移住した後もメッセージを交換していた。

sentences.en: They initially promised to speak online every evening, hoping that their regular conversations would preserve their close friendship.
sentences.ja: 当初毎晩オンラインで話すと約束し、定期的な会話が親しい友情を保つことを期待した。

sentences.en: Because of the time difference, however, one friend's evening often coincided with the other's busiest part of the day.
sentences.ja: しかし時差のため一人の夜はもう一人の一日の最も忙しい時間と重なることが多かった。

sentences.en: As their schedules became more demanding, they gradually found it difficult to keep their original promise.
sentences.ja: 予定が忙しくなるにつれ、もとの約束を守ることが徐々に難しくなった。

sentences.en: Maya began to worry whenever her friend did not respond immediately to a message she had sent.
sentences.ja: マヤは送ったメッセージに友人がすぐ返事をしないたびに心配し始めた。

sentences.en: She sometimes interpreted the silence as a sign that her friend was losing interest in their relationship.
sentences.ja: ときには沈黙を友人が関係への関心を失っているサインだと解釈した。

sentences.en: Her friend, meanwhile, felt uncomfortable because she could not always reply during school or family activities.
sentences.ja: 一方友人は学校や家庭の活動中にいつも返事ができるわけではなく、気まずく感じていた。

sentences.en: Neither person had intended to disappoint the other, but their different expectations had created unnecessary tension.
sentences.ja: どちらも相手をがっかりさせるつもりはなかったが、期待の違いが不要な緊張を生んでいた。

sentences.en: During a weekend conversation, they finally explained their concerns instead of continuing to guess what the other person was thinking.
sentences.ja: 週末の会話で、相手の考えを推測し続ける代わりにようやく懸念を説明し合った。

sentences.en: They discovered that both still valued the friendship but understood the meaning of a delayed response differently.
sentences.ja: 二人とも友情を大切にしていたが、返事の遅れの意味を異なって理解していたと分かった。

sentences.en: Together, they agreed that ordinary messages did not require immediate answers and that important conversations could be arranged in advance.
sentences.ja: 通常のメッセージには即時の返事は不要で、重要な会話は事前に予定できると合意した。

sentences.en: They also decided to exchange occasional photographs or recorded messages when a live conversation was inconvenient.
sentences.ja: リアルタイムの会話が難しいときには時折写真や録音メッセージを交換することも決めた。

sentences.en: At first, Maya found the new arrangement unfamiliar because she had associated frequent replies with emotional closeness.
sentences.ja: 当初マヤは頻繁な返事を心の近さと結びつけていたため、新しい取り決めに慣れなかった。

sentences.en: Over time, she began to appreciate thoughtful messages that arrived when her friend was able to concentrate on the conversation.
sentences.ja: やがて友人が会話に集中できるときに届く心のこもったメッセージをありがたく思うようになった。

sentences.en: Her friend also felt more comfortable initiating contact because every message no longer created an expectation of an immediate discussion.
sentences.ja: 友人も各メッセージが即時の会話への期待を生まなくなり、連絡を始めやすく感じた。

sentences.en: Their friendship had not become less meaningful simply because their way of communicating had changed.
sentences.ja: 伝え方が変わっただけで友情の意味が薄れたわけではなかった。

sentences.en: The two friends learned that maintaining a relationship across different circumstances may require adjusting habits rather than repeating old ones.
sentences.ja: 異なる状況で関係を保つには古い習慣を繰り返すより調整する必要がある場合があると学んだ。

sentences.en: They agreed to discuss their expectations again if their schedules changed in the future.
sentences.ja: 今後予定が変われば期待について再度話し合うと合意した。

sentences.en: A promise becomes useful when it reflects the practical needs of both people and can be reconsidered through honest communication.
sentences.ja: 約束は双方の実際の必要を反映し、率直な対話で見直せるとき役立つ。

sentences.en: For Maya, distance became less frightening once she understood that friendship was not measured only by the speed of a reply.
sentences.ja: マヤにとって友情が返事の速さだけで測られないと理解してから距離は以前ほど怖くなくなった。

questions.prompt: Why did the friends live in different countries?
options: They had never met in person.
Both traveled daily for school.
One of them had moved abroad.
They had decided to end their friendship.
questions.explanation_ja: 一人が海外へ移住した。

questions.prompt: Why was their original promise difficult to keep?
options: Their messages could only be sent on paper.
The time difference and increasingly busy schedules.
They had no common language.
They had lost all contact information.
questions.explanation_ja: 時差と忙しい予定が原因。

questions.prompt: How did Maya sometimes misunderstand a delayed reply?
options: She thought her friend was losing interest in the relationship.
She thought the message had arrived early.
She assumed her friend was studying the same topic.
She believed they had agreed never to talk.
questions.explanation_ja: 関心を失ったサインと解釈した。

questions.prompt: How did the other friend feel?
options: Relieved that the friendship had ended.
Angry that Maya lived abroad.
Certain that Maya never sent any messages.
Uncomfortable about not being able to respond during activities.
questions.explanation_ja: 活動中に返事できず気まずかった。

questions.prompt: What did they decide about ordinary messages?
options: They should always be answered in one minute.
They should contain no personal details.
They did not require immediate answers.
They would no longer be sent at all.

questions.prompt: What alternative to live conversations did they choose?
options: Photographs or recorded messages.
Daily international travel.
Messages sent only by a teacher.
A new online examination.
questions.explanation_ja: 写真や録音メッセージ。

questions.prompt: Why did Maya appreciate the new messages?
options: They always appeared at exactly the same time.
They included answers to every question.
They proved that distance no longer existed.
They were thoughtful and arrived when her friend could focus.
questions.explanation_ja: 集中できる時の心のこもった連絡を大切にした。

options: She stopped enjoying the friendship.

She was required to reply immediately.

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 時差により都合のよい時間が重ならなかった。

paraphrases.source: Neither person had intended to disappoint the other, but their different expectations had created unnecessary tension.
paraphrases.rewrite: Both had hoped not to let the other down, yet their expectations caused strain.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 双方に悪意はなかったが期待の違いが緊張を生んだ。

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 関係維持には習慣の調整が必要な場合がある。
